lessons.title: TH Sound Basics
lessons.text: I think the weather is beautiful today.
lessons.tip: For TH, place your tongue lightly between your teeth. Do not substitute F or D sounds.

lessons.title: American R
lessons.text: The red car turned right around the corner.
lessons.tip: Curl your tongue back without touching the roof of your mouth. Keep the sound smooth.

lessons.title: V vs W
lessons.text: We visited the vineyard over the weekend.
lessons.tip: For V, touch your lower lip to your upper teeth. For W, round your lips like saying oo.

lessons.title: Ship vs Sheep
lessons.text: I need to sit in this seat by the ship.
lessons.tip: Stretch your mouth wider for the long EE sound. Keep IH shorter and more relaxed.

lessons.title: Smooth Linking
lessons.text: I want to go out and get a cup of coffee.
lessons.tip: Link words naturally: want_to becomes wanna, cup_of becomes cuppa in casual speech.

lessons.title: Sentence Stress
lessons.text: I NEED to FINISH this REPORT by FRIDAY.
lessons.tip: Stress content words (nouns, verbs, adjectives). Reduce function words like to, the, and.

lessons.title: Even Pacing
lessons.text: Every morning I practice speaking clearly and confidently.
lessons.tip: Aim for about 130 to 150 words per minute. Pause briefly at commas, longer at periods.

lessons.title: Daily Introduction
lessons.text: Hi, my name is Rikesh and I work in technology.
lessons.tip: Smile slightly on HI. Hit the stressed syllables: NAME, WORK, tech-NOL-o-gy.

lessons.title: Asking Questions
lessons.text: Could you tell me where the nearest station is?
lessons.tip: Let your pitch rise at the end of questions. Keep could you soft and linked.

lessons.title: Professional Update
lessons.text: I completed the project ahead of schedule and shared the results with the team.
lessons.tip: Speak with steady confidence. Emphasize completed, ahead, results, and team.

lessons.title: Coffee Shop
lessons.text: Hi there, could I get a medium latte with oat milk, please?
lessons.tip: Sound warm and natural. Link could I and soften please at the end.

lessons.title: Meeting Opener
lessons.text: Thanks everyone for joining. Today we'll review the quarterly goals and next steps.
lessons.tip: Open with energy on thanks and joining. Slow down slightly on quarterly goals.

lessons.title: Phone Introduction
lessons.text: Hello, this is Rikesh calling about the interview scheduled for tomorrow.
lessons.tip: Speak slightly slower on the phone. Enunciate your name and the key noun interview.
